guide.title: How access works
guide.one: Role permissions are combined across all active roles.
guide.two: An account can receive independent allows or explicit denies. A deny takes precedence.
guide.three: Data scope can be limited to a company, department, department tree, own account or selected departments.
guide.four: The server verifies every request and applies tenant and data-scope conditions in SQL.

temporary.title: Temporary access
temporary.subtitle: Request permissions or a broader data scope for a limited time.
temporary.approvalHint: Review other accounts’ requests within your permanent authority. Self-approval is prohibited.
temporary.scopeHint: Request access for your own records or for the tenant. The reviewer may adjust permissions, scope and duration.
temporary.policyHint: Explicit denies remain effective. Approval and policy administration cannot be granted temporarily. Approved relative ranges are fixed at approval. Security-sensitive identity, credential, policy and membership changes still require permanent authority.
temporary.durationHint: Validity starts at approval and ends automatically on the server.
temporary.revokeHint: The active temporary grant will stop authorizing the next request.

memberships.title: Department access
memberships.hint: Each department has its own roles and permission overrides. Switch departments to use that context.
memberships.adminHint: Full administrator access is protected in the primary department. Add or select an additional department to configure its roles and permissions independently.
memberships.restricted: Department access requires permission administration. Only the built-in administrator can edit their own department memberships.

policy.ruleConflict: This rule duplicates or contradicts a preceding rule.
policy.unknownAction: The action and resource are absent from the current capability catalog.
policy.missingFilter: The capability does not declare this row filter. Matching requests will be denied.
policy.missingMask: The capability does not declare this field for masking. Matching requests will be denied.
policy.missingAttribute: No trusted resource attribute is available for this action. Matching requests will be denied.
policy.subject: Simulation account and department
policy.title: Access governance
policy.subtitle: Review and publish authorization restrictions in the current tenant.
policy.author: Author
policy.historyHelp: Current version: {{version}}. The latest 50 versions are shown. Publishing requires a different administrator with permanent management access over the entire tenant.
policy.rulesHelp: Enter a JSON array with action, resource and effect. Effects are deny, require_binding, require_attribute, filter_row and mask_output. Row filters require a supported resource attribute. Output masking requires a declared optional field. An empty array removes additional restrictions.
policy.reasonHelp: Explain why these restrictions should change.
policy.invalidRules: Enter a valid array of up to 100 structured authorization rules.
policy.createHelp: Start from the current published rules. Saving creates an immutable draft; it does not change live access.
policy.stale: The published policy has changed since this draft was created. Create a new draft from the current version.
policy.selfApproval: Another administrator must review and publish your draft.
policy.publishHelp: Publish this exact draft for the current tenant. This changes live authorization and invalidates cached access. The server rejects self-approval and outdated versions.
policy.rollbackHelp: Copy this previously published version into a new draft based on the current policy. A different administrator must approve it before it takes effect.
policy.simulationHelp: Select an action and optionally an account and department. The decision uses that context’s current formal access. Leave the account blank to simulate your own context.

risk.repeatedAuthenticationHelp: Accounts with at least five recorded failures in the selected window.
risk.title: Access risks
risk.help: Review signals in the current tenant. Authentication counts cover recorded failures for known accounts; these signals do not replace an investigation or access review.
risk.grantsHelp: Active custom role assignments with sensitive management permissions. Up to 50 assignments are shown, with permanent assignments first and then the earliest expirations. The total counts all matching assignments.
risk.denialsHelp: Actions with at least five denials in the selected window, grouped by action and reason across accounts. Up to 50 groups are shown, most frequent first.
